## Requirements (from the contract)

1. Owner-bound slice only: the deduplicated physical-use fold — the
   Account owner's read that exposes physical incurred/billed/unknown
   use **separately from** logical scope totals (decomposition owner
   seam: Whole-vector reserve / physical-use fold, R5.12/R5.13 distinct
   operations of the same Account owner; PADR-R5-2 B.1 item 4, B.9 items
   3–4). Reuse lower-layer codecs/stores; consume predecessor contracts
   unchanged — R5.12's whole-vector `reserve` stands upstream; R5.6's
   `launch_bound` funding slice and R5.11's separate instrument
   run/Account stand beside (AC-1, AC-2).
2. Positive: logical capacity stays logical (`remaining`, `check`,
   `totals`, `consumed`/`reserved`/`slice_held` unchanged); physical
   incurred use counts each `(source_event, dimension)` charge once at
   its leaf-most node — propagated ancestor copies deduplicate to the
   charge; repeated reconcile/recovery settlement counts once; spent
   resources survive logical reversal (physical is never subtracted);
   execution-cost transfer settles once; instrument charges/roots stay
   separate from the subject's (`charged_to` strata, per-run roots)
   (AC-1; B.1 item 4; B.5).
3. Negative: retry/ancestor duplicates cannot create phantom physical
   use; actual above reserve counts fully (never clamped to the claim);
   an ambiguous failed response is unknown exposure — never zero;
   reversal/refund/release cannot create physical capacity or turn
   unknown into zero; existing logical totals remain compatible (AC-2;
   B.9 item 4).
4. Ownership/evidence: contributing-only REQ-D-006, REQ-E-102,
   REQ-E-103, REQ-E-204, REQ-E-207 mapped to numbered checks + actual
   evidence; achieved D/E recorded separately from owed R/P/actual-
   execution E; no full-target predicate claimed (primary owners R5.19
   AC-3 for REQ-D-006/REQ-E-207, R5.10 AC-3 for REQ-E-102, R5.9 AC-3 for
   REQ-E-103/REQ-E-204) (AC-3).
5. Scoped verification: fails-without regression; `cargo fmt --all
   --check` + owning-package tests; drift/removability/CI-mode checks
   only if touched; commands + passed/failed/skipped counts; scratch
   stores (AC-4).
6. Universal phase gate: green scope; REQ ids stamped in PR; owed
   predicates as DEFERRALS rows with owner/trigger/control; ADRs cover
   owned decisions; run/PR/BUILD_INDEX/LEDGER agree at true completion;
   O-01–O-08 + I-01–I-08 dispositions (AC-5).

## Acceptance criteria (from the contract)

- [ ] AC-1 (D/E; positive): owner fold exposes logical capacity
    separately from physical incurred/billed/unknown use; deduplicates
    ancestor propagation and repeated reconcile; preserves spent
    resources after reversal; transfers execution cost once; keeps
    instrument roots separate.
- [ ] AC-2 (D/E; negative): retry/ancestor duplicates, actual above
    reserve, ambiguous failed response, reversal/refund and release
    cannot create physical capacity or turn unknown into zero; existing
    logical totals remain compatible.
- [ ] AC-3 (D/E; ownership and evidence): every contributing target →
    numbered checks + actual evidence in the coverage register; achieved
    D/E separate from owed R/P / actual-execution E; no full-target
    claim (evidence dependency, not dispatch dependency).
- [ ] AC-4 (E/D; scoped verification): fails-without regression; fmt +
    owning-package tests; drift/removability/CI-mode when touched;
    counts recorded; scratch stores.
- [ ] AC-5 (D/E; universal phase gate): records agree; REQ stamps; DF
    rows for owed legs; clauses/invariants dispositioned.

## Plan

1. `crates/hh-budget/src/tree.rs` — `PhysicalUse` view + `UnknownExposure`
   rows: fold `model.call.completed{usage.available:false}` and
   `model.call.failed` without a `usage` member into
   `unknown_exposures`; `physical_use()` computes incurred (each
   `(source_event, dimension)` charge once, leaf-most, reverted-effect
   charges **included**) + `incurred_by_charged_to` strata + billed
   (deduplicated `spend_rows` micro-units per currency) + unknown. The
   logical projection (`consumed`/`reserved`/`slice_held`/`totals`) is
   untouched — additive read only.
2. `crates/hh-budget/src/account.rs` — `Account::physical_use()`
   delegating to the tree fold.
3. `crates/hh-experiment/src/engine.rs` — `consumed_vector` deduplicates
   propagated leaf/ancestor copies on `(source_event.event_id,
   dimension)` (rows without `source_event` count individually — legacy
   fixture compatibility); the settle charge then transfers execution
   cost once per dimension.
4. `crates/hh-results/src/projection.rs` — the `control.budget.consumed`
   fold in `project` deduplicates the same way (the
   `consumption.dimensions` view counts propagated copies once).
5. `crates/hh-budget/tests/r5_13.rs` — the AC-1/AC-2 battery over scratch
   `Store::open_test` runs; one regression in
   `crates/hh-results/tests/results.rs` driving propagated copies through
   settle → `budget_utilization` and the row's `consumption.dimensions`.
6. ADR — owned landing decisions (unknown-exposure fold classes, leaf-
   most dedup semantics, billed = deduplicated spend rows, no new
   primary dimension); revisit triggers + adr-index regenerate.
7. Run ledger; PR `docs/build/pr/R5.13.md`; §6.5 close.

## Split-trigger stop (CAP DISCIPLINE)

- **Trigger:** ≤750 changed source/test lines (contract size budget —
  split trigger, not target). Measured at checkpoint: **1,165**
  (`git diff --cached --numstat`: `tree.rs` +216/−1 = 217 + `account.rs`
  +12 + `lib.rs` +1/−1 + `engine.rs` +26/−3 = 29 + `projection.rs`
  +32/−1 = 33 + `tests/results.rs` +87 + `tests/r5_13.rs` +785; ≈1.55×).
  Added-only = 1,159 — over either way.
- **Stopped at:** after implementation + owning-package and consumer
  suites green + fails-without demonstrated, **before PR/close** — work
  committed on the branch as a checkpoint; no PR opened.
- **Battery minimality (recorded for the ruling):** the 785-line budget
  battery is the minimal-faithful set — 9 legs each covering a distinct
  AC clause (propagation dedup; view separation; reconcile/reprojection
  dedup; reversal survival; instrument-root separation; over-reserve;
  ambiguous/unknown exposure; release/completion no-capacity; billed
  dedup) plus one 87-line consumer regression proving
  experiment-settle utilization and the results row count propagated
  copies once. No leg can be dropped without dropping an AC; the
  owner-fold + consumer changes themselves are ~290 lines.
- **Proposed seam (if a split is ruled):** (a) the hh-budget
  `PhysicalUse` fold + `unknown_exposures` + `Account::physical_use`
  with the AC-1/AC-2 owner legs ≈ 640 lines; then (b) the consumer
  dedup (`consumed_vector`, results projection) + its regression ≈ 200.
  Leg (a) alone lands the owner view without the "count once in
  experiment/results" clause exercised; leg (b) alone ships dedup tests
  against no owner view — the two halves of one deduplication guarantee.
- **Alternative ruling:** AMEND — the physical-use fold and its
  consumer-side count-once dedup are one indivisible owner seam
  (PADR-R5-2 B.1 item 4 / B.3 "propagated leaf/ancestor copies count
  once in experiment/results"; decomposition owner seam — one Account
  owner, no documented sub-seam, no split contingency). The measured
  1,165 ≈ 1.55× sits between R5.12's 1.08× AMEND and R5.11's 2.4×
  AMEND. **Ruling:** **AMEND**.
